title: Maximum Number of Pairs in Array
summary: Given an integer array nums, perform operations by removing equal pairs of integers until no more can be removed.
statement: Given an integer array nums, perform operations by removing equal pairs of integers until no more can be removed. Return an array indicating the number of pairs formed and the count of remaining integers.
constraints: A pair contains two equal values and each input occurrence may be used once.
Form as many pairs as possible.
hints: A frequency f contributes floor(f/2) disjoint pairs.
Sum those pairs; every pair consumes two elements, so leftovers equal n-2*pairs.
Pairing within each value is independent and floor(f/2) is maximal, so their sum is globally maximal.
editorial: Pairing within each value is independent and floor(f/2) is maximal, so their sum is globally maximal.

tests.explanation: There is one pair for each of one, two, and three, leaving one extra two.
The two equal values form one pair with nothing left.
